body:
Any updates on this issue? We are also experiencing this problem and it is currently a major blocker for us.

Did some digging and it seems that the problem undefined is not respected as a valid input when min and max boundaries are set:

https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/blob/166db0903cd98b186ce361b10834fc2090dc9cab/packages/instantsearch.js/src/connectors/range/connectRange.ts#L204-L211

With minBound set, I don't see path where next newNextMin is undefined when the resolved state is updated.
